title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten distinct study environments with documented furniture, technology, access, or reservation constraints.

cards.title: Spread Out at Irwin
cards.subtitle: Irwin Library
cards.notes: Choose a study table for materials-heavy work and check the library calendar before planning an early session.
cards.short_summary: Traditional table seating in Butler’s main library.
cards.evidence_claim: Irwin Library states that it provides seating at study tables along with soft spaces and study rooms.
cards.access_notes: Public areas are available during posted library hours; leave at closing and follow the conduct policy.

cards.title: Meet Just Inside Irwin
cards.subtitle: Inside the entrance, to the right
cards.notes: Use this open collaborative area for group work and moderate your volume around adjacent library users.
cards.short_summary: A specifically located group-work area near Irwin’s entrance.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler identifies the Irwin Collaborative Space inside the front doors and to the right.
cards.access_notes: Use during Irwin Library hours; scheduled events may supersede informal use.

cards.title: Read Beyond the Collaborative Space
cards.subtitle: Irwin Library first floor
cards.notes: Check the event schedule before using the room; classes, seminars, and academic meetings receive priority.
cards.short_summary: A named Irwin room suitable when it is not reserved.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler locates the Great Books Room on Irwin’s first floor and says non-class use must be scheduled through campus systems.
cards.access_notes: Not an unrestricted drop-in room; classes, seminars, meetings, and scheduled events control availability.

cards.title: Reserve a Lower-Level Room
cards.subtitle: Irwin Library Room 003
cards.notes: Book up to one week ahead, keep within the daily four-hour limit, and arrive before the cancellation window.
cards.short_summary: A reservable one-to-two-person room on Irwin’s lower level.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler lists Room 003 as an individual study room for one to two people, reservable by current students.
cards.access_notes: Current Butler students only; one-hour increments, four hours per day, and 15-minute check-in rule.

cards.title: Book Room 230 for the Team
cards.subtitle: Irwin Library Room 230
cards.notes: Reserve before gathering, keep the group within the posted capacity, and yield if another group holds the booking.
cards.short_summary: A reservable Irwin group room for collaborative work.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler lists Room 230 among its group study rooms for two to nine people, depending on room size.
cards.access_notes: Current students only; reservations open one week ahead with a four-hour daily limit.

cards.entity_name: Ruth Lilly Science Library Open Study Area
cards.title: Settle into the Quiet Science Floor
cards.subtitle: Levinson Family Hall, second floor
cards.notes: Bring your Butler ID, use the whiteboards for active work, and preserve the library’s quiet-study culture.
cards.short_summary: A bright, quiet, card-access study floor with whiteboards.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler describes the Science Library as a quiet 24/7 space with varied study seating, windows, and whiteboards.
cards.access_notes: 24/7 card access for Butler students, faculty, and staff; bring a Butler ID.

cards.entity_name: Science Library Group Study Room LFH200D
cards.title: Put Equations on the Whiteboard
cards.subtitle: Levinson Family Hall Room 200D
cards.notes: Reserve the group room in advance and use available dry-erase tools without leaving work on the boards.
cards.short_summary: A bookable collaboration room inside the Science Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler lists LFH200D as a Science Library group study room and documents its reservation rules.
cards.access_notes: Current Butler students only; reserve up to one week ahead and observe the daily limit.

cards.entity_name: Science Library Individual Study Room LFH200E
cards.title: Take a Solo Science Room
cards.subtitle: Levinson Family Hall Room 200E
cards.notes: Reserve for focused one-to-two-person work, arrive on time, and keep the room available after your slot.
cards.short_summary: An individual room within the 24/7 Science Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler lists LFH200E as an individual Science Library study room intended for one to two people.
cards.access_notes: Current students only; one-hour increments, four-hour daily maximum, and timely check-in required.

cards.title: Work with Curriculum Materials
cards.subtitle: South Campus Main Building
cards.notes: Visit during weekday business hours for education resources; authorized users can check separate card access.
cards.short_summary: A self-service branch focused on education and curriculum resources.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler locates the Education Resource Library at South Campus and describes its curricular and professional collections.
cards.access_notes: All Butler users during weekday business hours in session; other card access is limited to designated COEHD users.

cards.title: Use a Booth Between Classes
cards.subtitle: Jordan Hall, second floor
cards.notes: Choose an open booth for compact individual or paired work and yield to posted academic programming.
cards.short_summary: Informal booth seating officially recommended to commuter students.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler lists Jordan Hall’s second-floor booths among campus soft spaces for studying or hanging out.
cards.access_notes: Available during Jordan Hall access hours and subject to posted restrictions.
